title: Horizon Eater — Sea Above Horizon Line Eater
role: P3 terminal monolith: distance itself is feeding anatomy. The horizon IS the mouth. Horizon disappearance = horizon eaten.
thesis: Do not build a giant mouth mesh. Build three simultaneous horizon kills that together make the horizon unreadable, then reveal the kills were filter-feeding anatomy. Beauty first, anatomy second.

how_horizon_disappears.summary: Horizon is killed by 3 overlapping mechanisms, ordered by authority. All three must be tunable via one scalar: HorizonEatAmount (0..1) on MPC_Melodia_Palette + WorldField.Tension.

kills.name: Oceanology Single Layer Water absorption kill (primary)
kills.authority: PRIMARY — the scale trick from SEA_ABOVE_SECOND_OCEAN_LAYOUT_AND_CAMERA_PLAN_2026-08-29.md section 3
kills.mechanism: False ocean plane at Z -50m is seen THROUGH real Oceanology SLW. Real ocean MI (M_Water_Oceanology_Melodia_Inst) absorption+scattering attenuates the false ocean. Tuning absorption to extinguish FASTER than 50m of water justifies makes the brain read kilometres of attenuation over metres of geometry.

params.volume: AOceanologyWaterVolume (currently 2m cube — must scale to enclose false plane)
params.extinction_depth_target: Measure first: pull SLW Absorption RGB * Depth param, compute extinction = -ln(0.01)/absorption. Place plane at 70-80% of extinction. If extinction < 50m, horizon already eaten at rest.
params.kill_scalar: MPC_Melodia_Palette.HorizonEatAmount 0..1 drives: Absorption * (1 + HorizonEat*3.0), DeepScatteringColor lerp toward horizon fog color, Biolum_Weight 0.35 * (1 - HorizonEat*0.9)
params.tension_binding: WorldField.Tension = HorizonEatAmount (single bus). UMelodiaAudioReactivePresentationSubsystem is sole writer.
params.verification: From hero overlook (LV_SeaAbove_Prototype CineCameraActor), capture mid-ground Fresnel band: at HorizonEat 0.0 band visible, at 0.6 band fades, at 1.0 horizon gone + false ocean reads as membrane pulse.

kills.why_not_height_fog: ExponentialHeightFog governs above-water horizon only. Sub-surface horizon kill is SLW path. Height fog is secondary (kill B companion).

kills.name: ExponentialHeightFog + VolumetricCloud + moon-haze volume kill (companion)
kills.mechanism: Height fog density + volumetric extinction swallows the above-water horizon line. VolumetricCloud under-sky mirror collapses. FM_MoonHaze_VolumeBox (FrostBloom) density 0.04->0.18 with tint shift.

params.kill_scalar: Density = 0.04 + HorizonEat*0.14, MaxOpacity 0.85 + HorizonEat*0.15, Volumetric Fog Extinction 1.5 + HorizonEat*2.0
params.color_lerp: Fog tint lerp toward (0.55,0.60,0.72) desaturated as eaten (kills blue horizon read)
params.cloud: VolumetricCloud layer: extinction + HorizonEat* 0.8, horizon cloud horizon line softens

kills.name: LOD3 HLOD impostor crumble + PCG density cull (terrain horizon kill)
kills.mechanism: Distant terrain/kitbash at horizon uses HLOD impostor LOD3 (VistaImpostor_ZeroShimmer: res 128, POM0, Toksvig 1.0, rim 1.8, WPO 0). Bayer 8x8 + BlueNoise 64x64 dithered opacity destroys impostor as HorizonEat rises. PCG points near horizon have density *= (1 - HorizonEat) via PCGEx cull, plus advection toward feeding corridor.

params.dither: T_LOD_BayerDither_8x8 + T_LOD_BlueNoise_64x64 + TemporalAA jitter, DitherTemporalAA node, OpacityMaskClipValue = DitherValue < (HorizonEat * TensionMask)
params.hlod: HLOD_FarawayMother_Instanced (instanced) + HLOD_FarawayMother_Merged (merged) — eaten variants keep same bounds but impostor alpha -> 0
params.pcg: PCG_HorizonEater_FilterFlow graph: density remap, filter-flow vector advects distant points toward horizon mouth corridor (see Tools/PCG/build_horizon_eater_ecosystem.py)
params.tension_gate: Only crumble where Tension > 0.6 OR distance > 1500m (WeaveRidge high tension + Residue Seam Way). Valley (FrillValley T<0.4) persists longer — eaten last.

single_scalar_contract.writer: UMelodiaAudioReactivePresentationSubsystem (sole writer of MPC_Melodia_Palette) — never add second writer
single_scalar_contract.consumer_readonly: UMelodiaCymaticsSubsystem (IsReadOnlyByContract=true) + all MIs read MPC only via scalar param collections
single_scalar_contract.scalar: MPC_Melodia_Palette.HorizonEatAmount 0..1 (new, additive — safe no-op if missing)
single_scalar_contract.aliases: WorldField.Tension = HorizonEatAmount, WorldField.HorizonEat mirrors it, BeatPulse still drives pulse on same bus (see klein_veil_manifest mpc_wiring)
single_scalar_contract.driven_by: Rhythm accuracy + SeaAbove Bell pulse + Faraway Mother Tension meeting at horizon. 0 = pristine horizon, 1 = horizon gone/membrane revealed. DissonanceAmount (tension MPC) can mirror for audio.
single_scalar_contract.guardrail: No new MPC asset. Add scalar to existing MPC_Melodia_Palette via Content/Python/add_horizon_eater_mpc_params.py (pattern: add_tension_mpc_params.py). Reads on missing param are no-ops.

bell_as_horizon.layout_rule: Bell crown tangent to false ocean plane along hero sightline. Current blockout has plane at -50m + sphere at -180m (diagnostic, not hero). Final: Bell R ~3km, sag = R - sqrt(R^2 - d^2). At d=1.2km (attenuation horizon) sag ~251m. Crown just beneath plane, bulk falls by curvature.
bell_as_horizon.reveal: At HorizonEat 1.0, radial anatomy travels across false ocean via emissive pulse (Biolum pulse), recontextualizing plane as membrane. Two gates: 'Bell perimeter hidden' + 'pulse creates biological realization' must both pass from hero overlook.

levels.sea_above: LV_SeaAbove_Prototype — primary horizon eater stage (ocean + false ocean + fog + droplets). Horizon kill A+B+C all present.
levels.faraway_mother: LV_FarawayMother_Prototype — secondary: fabric mountain horizon eaten by same scalar (LOD destruction). Wayfold destination beyond eaten horizon.

pcgex.graph: PCG_HorizonEater_FilterFlow (PCGEx-bridged): Input: WorldField.Tension + distance + Chladni nodal. Ops: DensityRemap (1 - HorizonEat * HorizonMask), VectorAdvect (filter-flow corridor toward horizon mouth), DitherCull (Bayer+BlueNoise clip), HeightAware raycast (Visibility 50000->-50000).
pcgex.datasets: FilterFlowField curves + DistanceEvidenceScatter points + HorizonMouthCorridor splines (from HDA_P3_HorizonMouthComposer exports).
